Tally coverage by line, expression or function

Source: R/summary_functions.R
tally_coverage.Rd

Tally coverage by line, expression or function

Usage

tally_coverage(x, by = c("line", "expression", "function"))

Arguments

x

the coverage object returned from package_coverage()

by

whether to tally coverage by line, expression or function

Value

A data.frame. With by = "expression" it is the same as as.data.frame.coverage(). With by = "line" it has one row for each line of code (excluding blank and comment lines of R code) and the columns filename, functions, line and value, where value is the smallest execution count of the expressions on that line, so a line only counts as covered if all its expressions were run.

With by = "function" it has one row for each top level R function and the columns filename, functions, first_line, last_line and value, where first_line and last_line span the function's traced code and value is the largest execution count of its expressions, so a function counts as covered if any of its code was run. Compiled code has no function names, so it is left out.

Examples

cov <- code_coverage(
  "f <- function(x) {\n  if (x) 'yes' else 'no'\n}\ng <- function() 1",
  "f(TRUE)"
)
tally_coverage(cov)
#>                               filename functions line value
#> 1 /tmp/RtmpB91yGd/source.R181f324aac97         f    2     0
#> 2 /tmp/RtmpB91yGd/source.R181f324aac97         g    4     0
tally_coverage(cov, by = "expression")
#>                               filename functions first_line first_byte
#> 1 /tmp/RtmpB91yGd/source.R181f324aac97         f          2          7
#> 2 /tmp/RtmpB91yGd/source.R181f324aac97         f          2         10
#> 3 /tmp/RtmpB91yGd/source.R181f324aac97         f          2         21
#> 4 /tmp/RtmpB91yGd/source.R181f324aac97         g          4          6
#>   last_line last_byte first_column last_column first_parsed last_parsed value
#> 1         2         7            7           7            2           2     1
#> 2         2        14           10          14            2           2     1
#> 3         2        24           21          24            2           2     0
#> 4         4        17            6          17            4           4     0
tally_coverage(cov, by = "function")
#>                               filename functions first_line last_line value
#> 1 /tmp/RtmpB91yGd/source.R181f324aac97         f          2         2     1
#> 2 /tmp/RtmpB91yGd/source.R181f324aac97         g          4         4     0
